scripts.text: I've heard stories of the many adventurers from your lands. But, I haven't been able to talk with them much because they were always busy.
scripts.translation: 我聽說過許多來自你們那裡的冒險者的故事。不過，因為他們總是很忙，所以我沒機會和他們多聊幾句。

scripts.text: I just wanted to hear about news from other lands...
scripts.translation: 我只是想聽聽其他地方的訊息...

scripts.text: Sorry to bother you. You have a good trip.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾你了。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text: I've heard that interesting creatures inhabit your lands. Could you please tell me about at least one of them?
scripts.translation: 我聽說你們那裡棲息著一些有趣的生物。能請你至少給我講講其中一種嗎？

scripts.text: This is a card of one of the monsters that inhabit the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation: 這是米德加爾特大陸上棲息的一種魔物的卡片。

scripts.text: W, wait.. I've got one somewhere!
Hooh, it is.. I can't believe this is real.
scripts.translation: 哦，原來如此...真不敢相信這是真的。

scripts.text: Thank you for showing me this.
By the way, do you like this place?
scripts.translation: 順便問一下，你喜歡這個地方嗎？

scripts.text: Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.
scripts.translation: 現在冬天過去了，夏天即將到來，天氣很好。雖然我知道每年冬天都會回來，但我總是祈禱它不要再來了。

scripts.text: After the passing of winter, the summer weather has made the forest dense and the air so warm. My favorite season will always be summer.
scripts.translation: 冬天過後，夏天的天氣讓森林變得茂密，空氣也溫暖起來。我最喜歡的季節永遠是夏天。

scripts.text: But, don't forget that you should still be careful. Lots of adventurers were lost in the forst in front of us.
scripts.translation: 但是，別忘了你還是要小心。在我們面前的森林裡，有很多冒險者迷路了。

scripts.text: Have any of the adventurers returned?
Only one has come back and told me of a mysterious stone, where the road splits into three, that curses those who touch it so I've been keeping away from it.
scripts.translation: 只有一人回來了，他告訴我在一處道路分岔成三的地方有一塊神秘的石頭，觸控它的人會遭到詛咒，所以我一直避開那裡。

scripts.text: But, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.
scripts.translation: 不過，別擔心我。我對這裡很熟悉，也不怕魔物，哈哈.。

scripts.text: Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.

scripts.text: Me? Haha, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.
scripts.translation: 我？哈哈，別擔心我。我對這裡很熟悉，也不怕魔物，哈哈.。

scripts.text: This is not where you belong.
scripts.translation: 這裡不是你該來的地方。

scripts.text: Why did you disregard the warnings on the stone?
scripts.translation: 你為何無視石頭上的警告？

scripts.text: Are you the reason adventurers are getting lost around this forest?
scripts.translation: 難道你就是導致冒險者在這片森林迷路的原因嗎？

scripts.text: He doesn't want anyone to wander around the forest.
scripts.translation: 他不想讓任何人在這片森林徘徊。

scripts.text: His name is Koshei, the Immortal...
scripts.translation: 他的名字是不死者 科舍伊...

scripts.text: and he has been freed from his captivity... You'd better leave before he finds you.
scripts.translation: 而且他已經被釋放了...你最好在他發現你之前離開。

scripts.text: Unless you want to be killed, leave now.
scripts.translation: 除非你想死，否則現在就離開。
- 跳進了你身後的灌木叢裡！！ -

scripts.text: I'm not afraid of your warning 'cuz I'm not as weak as you think I am!
scripts.translation: 我不怕你的警告，因為我並不像你想像的那麼弱！

scripts.text: Your attack from before was a cheapshot! If you have something to do with the missing people around here, you won't be forgiven!
scripts.translation: 你剛才的攻擊是偷襲！如果你和這裡失蹤的人有關，我絕不會原諒你！

scripts.text: Stop it. You cannot beat me.
Take your position. I won't take you by surprise!!!
scripts.translation: 擺好架勢。我不會偷襲你的！！！

scripts.text: ... Yes, I think that I've been waiting for someone like you.
scripts.translation: ... 是的，我想我一直在等待像你這樣的人。

scripts.text: I need brave adventurers, like you, to help me. Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 我需要像你這樣勇敢的冒險者來幫我。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: No, how can I trust you?
Hu.. you won't. But, I ask you again. Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 呼... 你拒絕了我。但我再問一次。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: ... Ok, ok. There's no way I can refuse this type of request.
scripts.translation: ...好吧，好吧。這種請求我沒法拒絕。

scripts.text: So, what do you want me to do?
This isn't a good place to talk. Get on my back, I will show you something.
scripts.translation: 這裡不是說話的好地方。騎到我背上來，我帶你去看樣東西。

scripts.text: - He turns his back to me -
This is an adventurer from another land. He is not afraid of Koshei. He may be able to help you.
scripts.translation: 這是一位來自異鄉的冒險者。他並不害怕科舍伊。也許他能幫到你。

scripts.text: Help me? Do you think he can stop Koshei?
scripts.translation: 幫我？你覺得他能阻止科舍伊嗎？

scripts.text: Ah, hold on. Who is Koshei and who is talking?
scripts.translation: 啊，等一下。科舍伊是誰？還有，是誰在說話？

scripts.text: Koshei.. He is an immortal and endless evil. I fought against him a long tim ago. After a fierce fight, I had to seal him in the darkness because he is immortal.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊...他是永生不滅的邪惡。很久以前我曾與他戰鬥。經過一場激戰，我不得不將他封印在黑暗中，因為他是不死的。

scripts.text: And as a result I became imprisoned in this wall.
scripts.translation: 結果我也被囚禁在這面牆裡。

scripts.text: He has found a way to break away from his seal and I fear for the worst.
scripts.translation: 他找到了打破封印的方法，我擔心最壞的情況會發生。

scripts.text: My name is Maria Morebna. Help me exterminate Koshei. I want to keep peace in Moscovia. Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 我叫瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜。幫我消滅科舍伊。我想讓莫斯科比亞保持和平。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: So, how can I help you?
First, you need to find a way to get her out of there.
scripts.translation: 首先，你得想辦法把她從牆裡救出來。

scripts.text: I've heard about a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything. There is a keymaker in town.
scripts.translation: 我聽說有一把^0000ff“黃金鑰匙^000000”，能開啟任何東西。鎮上有位鑰匙匠。

scripts.text: As you see, I look like a monster so I am not able to go there. I want you to find this keymaker and ask about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation: 你也看到了，我看起來像魔物，所以我無法去那裡。我想讓你去找這位鑰匙匠，問問關於^0000ff“黃金鑰匙”^000000的事。

scripts.text: Help me get out of here.
scripts.translation: 幫我把我從這裡弄出去。

scripts.text: I hope you can help me find that '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything.
scripts.translation: 我希望你能幫我找到那把^0000ff能開啟任何^000000東西的“黃金鑰匙”。

scripts.text: I've heard about a keymaker in Moscovia who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation: 我聽說莫斯科比亞有一位鑰匙匠，他知道如何制^0000ff作“黃金鑰^000000匙”。

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
...I need golden thread. I heard that I was able to get it from Marozka. He....
scripts.translation: ...我需要金線。我聽說可以從馬羅茲卡那裡得到。他...

scripts.text: Marozka... He is the owner of winter and dwells in the deep underground. He won't let just anyone see him.
scripts.translation: 馬羅茲卡...他是冬天的主人，居住在深深的地下。他不會讓隨便什麼人見到他。

scripts.text: He has monsters that guard his underground lair. It's very dangerous. But, I know where he is.
scripts.translation: 他有魔物守衛著地下的巢穴。那裡非常危險。但是，我知道他在哪裡。

scripts.text: What do you think? I can open a portal to the cave Do you want to go there now?
scripts.translation: 你覺得怎麼樣？我可以開啟一個通往洞穴的傳送門。你想現在去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: ... When you're ready, just tell me.
scripts.translation: ...當你準備好的時候，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text: ...Ok, be careful There are a lot of monsters there.
scripts.translation: ...好的，小心點。那裡有很多魔物。

scripts.text: Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation: 還沒有...請給我一點時間。

scripts.text: If you gather all the necessary things, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation: 如果你收集齊了所有必要的東西，就去莫斯科比亞找那位鑰匙匠。請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text: I collected every meterial for the key, But have not yet got the key...
scripts.translation: 我收集齊了製作鑰匙的所有材料，但還沒有拿到鑰匙...

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia and find the keymaker.
scripts.translation: 去莫斯科比亞找那位鑰匙匠。

scripts.text: Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation: 還沒有...請給我一點時間。

scripts.text: If you gather all the things necessary, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation: 如果你收集齊了所有必要的東西，就去莫斯科比亞找那位鑰匙匠。請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text: I can feel Koshei's energy.. It is not a time to use the key...
scripts.translation: 我能感覺到科舍伊的能量...現在不是使用鑰匙的時候...

scripts.text: I did. So, how do I use it?
scripts.translation: 我做到了。那麼，我該怎麼使用它？

scripts.text: Left the key up, and shout '^0000ffThe Free wind blows and gets you wherever you want^000000'.
scripts.translation: 舉起鑰匙，然後大喊^0000ff“自由的風會把你吹向任何你想去的地^000000方”。

scripts.text: I'm finally out of there! Now I can.....................aaaaak!!!....
scripts.translation: 我終於出來了！現在我可以...啊啊啊——！...

scripts.text: I really want to thank you, human. Maria was imprisoned in the wall so I couldn't do anything!
scripts.translation: 我真想謝謝你，人類。瑪麗亞被囚禁在牆裡，我什麼都做不了！

scripts.text: She'll thank me for giving her a quick death!!
scripts.translation: 她一定會感謝我給了她一個痛快的死法！！

scripts.text: But you, human... You are here to disturb me?
scripts.translation: 但是，人類...你是來打擾我的嗎？

scripts.text: No one can stop me! Now, die!!!
scripts.translation: 沒有人能阻止我！現在，去死吧！！！

scripts.text: You think you can fight me?!
Listen, I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
scripts.translation: 聽著，如果我現在就治療她，我還能救瑪麗亞。

scripts.text: I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation: 我會帶著她逃走，留你一個人去對付科舍伊！！

scripts.text: Stop! Where do you think you're going?!!!
scripts.translation: 站住！你以為你能逃到哪裡去？！！！
我能感覺到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text: I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
scripts.translation: 如果我現在就治療她，我還能救瑪麗亞。

scripts.text: I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation: 我會帶著她逃走，留你一個人去對付科舍伊！！
但是，她的情況仍然不穩定。

scripts.text: To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation: 要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她會知道該怎麼做。

scripts.text: I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation: 我撐不了太久了。你必須找到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.translation: 我會帶著她逃走，留你一個人去對付科舍伊！！

scripts.text: Did you get the 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'?
scripts.translation: 你拿到“生命之水”和“死亡之水”了嗎？
我拿到了！瑪麗亞怎麼樣了？！

scripts.text: I fear that her spirit has gone. Severe wounds and curses are hindering her spirit from coming back. But we can save her with that water.
scripts.translation: 恐怕她的靈魂已經離開了。嚴重的傷勢和詛咒阻礙了她的靈魂迴歸。但我們可以用那些水來救她。

scripts.text: What are you doing?! I told you we did not have much time! What are you going to do now?!
scripts.translation: 你在幹什麼？！我告訴過你時間不多了！你現在打算怎麼辦？！

scripts.text: I am so sorry. But some water is left...
scripts.translation: 非常抱歉。但還剩下一些水...

scripts.text: ...!? No, not 'Death Water'.. I should pour 'Life Water'.......
scripts.translation: ...！？不，不是“死亡之水”...應該倒入“生命之水”...

scripts.text: Hehehe, you can trust me. Next is the 'Life Water'.
scripts.translation: 呵呵呵，你可以信任我。接下來是“生命之水”。

scripts.text: You saved me. I really appreicate it. Thank you for helping us fight against Koshei.
scripts.translation: 你救了我。我非常感激。謝謝你幫助我們對抗科舍伊。

scripts.text: And you, Gray Wolf.. Thank you for protecting me while I was helpless.
scripts.translation: 還有你，灰狼...謝謝你在我無助的時候保護我。

scripts.text: Koshei wasn't completely destroyed. But, his power has weakened, it shouldn't be hard to seal his power without me also being sealed.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊並沒有被完全消滅。但他的力量已經減弱，即使沒有我也應該不難封印他的力量。

scripts.text: Koshei and I are bound by magic. If one's power should be sealed, the other must be sealed as well.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊和我被魔法繫結在一起。如果一方的力量被封印，另一方也必須被封印。

scripts.text: But the original seal weakened over time and Koshei was able to get out of his confinement. That is why I asked you to get me out of here.
scripts.translation: 但最初的封印隨著時間推移而減弱，科舍伊得以逃脫束縛。這就是為什麼我讓你把我救出來。

scripts.text: He realized that I was trying to break free and waited here for anyone who would help me. I never ever expected it...
scripts.translation: 他意識到我想掙脫束縛，便在這裡等待任何會幫助我的人。我從未想到過這一點...

scripts.text: Anyway, I'm so grateful for everything you did.
scripts.translation: 總之，我非常感激你所做的一切。

scripts.text: Please accept my poor reward, I hope that it will be of some help for such a brave adventurer. I hope that the gods will bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation: 請收下我微薄的獎勵，希望這對勇敢的冒險者有所幫助。願眾神保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text: It's been a long time since I've felt the sunlight, fresh wind and the scent of grass. I'm so grateful.
scripts.translation: 我已經很久沒有感受到陽光、清新的微風和草地的芬芳了。我非常感激。

scripts.text: ... Koshei is immortal and will surely appear again someday...
scripts.translation: ...科舍伊是不死的，總有一天他一定會再次出現...

scripts.text: When that time comes, I will deal with him. I will use my time of waiting to train to make myself strong whenever he returns...
scripts.translation: 當那一天來臨時，我會親自解決他。我會利用等待的時間磨練自己，變得更強，無論他何時歸來...

scripts.text: I'm grateful that you did your best for me and my village. I will never forget your kindness.
scripts.translation: 我很感激你為了我和村莊竭盡全力。我永遠不會忘記你的善意。

scripts.text: Ah, Go to Baba Yaga in your free time. She seems to have something to tell you.
scripts.translation: 啊，有空的時候去找找芭芭雅嘎吧。她似乎有話要告訴你。

scripts.text: Take care of yourself. It is better for you to stay away from here because, Koshei may try to use your power as his own, huhu.
scripts.translation: 請保重。最好離這裡遠一點，因為科舍伊可能會試圖利用你的力量為己用，呼呼。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying that much?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要帶這麼多東西？
是在為某件事做準備嗎？

scripts.text: But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation: 不過，我聽說有些人在這座村莊附近島嶼的森林裡迷路了。這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?

scripts.text: Excuse me, have you heard of a keymaker who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation: 打擾一下，你聽說過會製作“黃金鑰匙^0000ff”的鑰匙匠^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, are you an adventurer? Who told you about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你是冒險者嗎？是誰告訴你“黃^0000ff金鑰匙”的^000000事的？

scripts.text: Well, then... The keymaker for the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation: 那麼...關於“黃金^0000ff鑰匙”的鑰^000000匙匠。

scripts.text: You are very lucky to have asked me about this.
I'm the only one in this town that knows what materials are needed to make the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'! Bahaha!
scripts.translation: 我是這個鎮上唯一知道製作“黃金鑰匙”需要哪些^0000ff材料的人^000000！巴哈哈！

scripts.text: Ah, oh yes! How could I forget?
We came here from Moscovia together. He called himself Igg. I came here with him but parted with him quite a while ago. He was sad because he couldn't forget about his lost lover.
scripts.translation: 我們是從莫斯科比亞一起過來的。他自稱伊格。我和他一起來到這裡，但很久以前就分開了。他很傷心，因為他無法忘記他失去的愛人。

我不知道他具體在哪裡。

scripts.text: Huh, more and more adventurers are settling here recently, so it's hard to tell who is a villager or an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 嗯，最近越來越多的冒險者定居在這裡，很難分辨誰是村民，誰是冒險者。

scripts.text: But natives, like me, can tell the difference.

scripts.text: As I was saying, I like this village. The desert is hot and Kafra staff is even hotter!!! *hack* *cough*!!
scripts.translation: 正如我剛才說的，我很喜歡這個村莊。沙漠很熱，卡普拉的職員們更熱！！！*咳* *咳咳*！！

scripts.text: Ah, but don't get me wrong! I'm not coughing because of the Kafra Staffers. It's uhh the heat, it's getting to me... ya...
scripts.translation: 啊，別誤會！我咳嗽不是因為卡普拉的職員。是...是天氣太熱了，有點受不了...咳...

scripts.text: The hell you talking about..? I'm looking for someone.
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼鬼話...？我在找人。

scripts.text: I see so many adventurers around here, how can I remember everybody? Got any descriptions of this someone..? Or traits..? anything to help me remember.
scripts.translation: 這裡到處都是冒險者，我怎麼可能記得住每個人？你有那個人的描述嗎...？或者特徵...？任何能幫我想起來的線索。

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't know how he looks like but he is from a land called Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不記得他長什麼樣，但他來自一個叫莫斯科比亞的地方。

scripts.text: Ah, are you talking about a guy that's always sad and dresses funny? I figured his accent wasn't from around here...
scripts.translation: 啊，你說的是那個總是很悲傷、穿著很奇怪的人嗎？我早就覺得他的口音不像本地人...

scripts.text: He was here a coupla days ago but he left to see the Pyramid. I never saw him after that. I said it would be dangerous but he went anyways.
scripts.translation: 他幾天前在這裡，但後來去金字塔了。從那以後我就沒見過他。我說過那裡很危險，但他還是去了。

scripts.text: Yep that's gotta be who you're looking for. I can see his gloomy face right now... that poor sad man.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，那肯定就是你要找的人。我現在還能看到他那張陰鬱的臉...那個可憐又悲傷的男人。

scripts.text: Many travellers in the village and I feel fun to see them. Even though I am here, I feel like that I travel all around the world?
scripts.translation: 村裡有很多旅行者，看到他們我覺得很有趣。雖然我一直待在這裡，卻感覺像是環遊了全世界？

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
...I don't know who you are. Just get outta my face. I don't want to talk...
scripts.translation: ...我不知道你是誰。從我面前滾開。我不想說話...

scripts.text: It's pretty dangerous here. There are fierce monsters all over the place.
scripts.translation: 這裡很危險。到處都是兇猛的魔物。

scripts.text: ... Good. Let them come. I want to die here alone.
scripts.translation: ...很好。讓它們來吧。我想在這裡孤獨地死去。

scripts.text: A-Are you Igor? What're you talking about? Have you gone nuts?
scripts.translation: 你...你是伊戈爾嗎？你在說什麼？你瘋了嗎？

scripts.text: Do you have any idea how much your lover is suffering?
scripts.translation: 你知道你的愛人正在承受多大的痛苦嗎？

scripts.text: I brought a message from her. She says not to suffer anymore and to just be happy...
scripts.translation: 我帶來了她的信。她說不要再受苦了，只要快樂就好...

scripts.text: The more you suffer, the deeper she sinks into sadness. Don't think that you're the only one that's suffering...
scripts.translation: 你越痛苦，她就陷得越深。別以為只有你一個人在受苦...

scripts.text: Wait, how could you...? She... how do I know that she really spoke to you?!
scripts.translation: 等等，你怎麼會...？她...我怎麼知道她真的跟你說過話？！

scripts.text: I met her by accident. She became Lusalka in the marsh of Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 我偶然遇見了她。她在莫斯科比亞的沼澤裡變成了盧薩爾卡。

scripts.text: She told me that you wouldn't believe me so she gave me these earrings as proof... The present that you gave to her.
scripts.translation: 她說你不會相信我，所以給了我這對耳環作為證明...那是你送給她的禮物。
她真的變成了盧薩爾卡？

scripts.text: It was near the end of the harsh Moscovia winter... She... didn't realize that the ice on the marsh was already melting...
scripts.translation: 那是莫斯科比亞嚴冬的末尾...她...沒有意識到沼澤上的冰已經開始融化了...

scripts.text: By then, it was too late the ice cracked where she was and she fell into the freezing cold marsh.
scripts.translation: 等到發現時已經太遲了，她腳下的冰裂開了，她掉進了冰冷刺骨的沼澤裡。

scripts.text: She wasn't able to swim. I tried to get her out but it was impossible.
scripts.translation: 她不會游泳。我試圖把她拉上來，但根本做不到。

scripts.text: She sunk quickly into the marsh. I was able to reach her hand but, she realized that it would kill both of us and she released my hand... I regret that moment every single day.
scripts.translation: 她迅速沉入了沼澤。我抓住了她的手，但她意識到這樣會害死我們兩個人，於是鬆開了手...我每天都在為那一刻感到後悔。

scripts.text: My last memory of her was of her smiling, as she sunk into the cold, wet marsh. As if to say, 'You will be ok.'
scripts.translation: 我對她最後的記憶，是她微笑著沉入冰冷潮溼的沼澤。彷彿在說：“你會沒事的。”

scripts.text: I, I was a coward. I was too afraid of drowning to pull her out of the marsh. Too afraid of....
scripts.translation: 我...我是個懦夫。我太害怕溺水了，不敢把她從沼澤里拉上來。太害怕...了...

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
I knew that she had become the cursed nymph Lusalka. But, I still went every night... to find her. I just wanted to see her and talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我知道她變成了被詛咒的精靈盧薩爾卡。但我還是每晚都去...尋找她。我只是想看看她，和她說話。

scripts.text: She told me that she also wanted to see you. But, she was afraid that Lusalka's curse would kill you if you saw her.
scripts.translation: 她說她也想見你。但她害怕盧薩爾卡的詛咒會在你看到她時奪走你的性命。

scripts.text: How could she think of me...
Don't be sad. She still loves you. Your suffering is her suffering.
scripts.translation: 別難過。她依然愛著你。你的痛苦就是她的痛苦。
...她真的嗎？謝謝你。你給了我鼓勵。

scripts.text: I will go back to Moscovia. But, I'm not well enough at the moment to go back.
scripts.translation: 我會回到莫斯科比亞的。但我現在的狀態還不夠好，無法立刻回去。

scripts.text: Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
scripts.translation: 請你去見她，把我的話告訴她好嗎？

scripts.text: I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation: 我記得和她在一起的每一個瞬間...我依然愛著她。

scripts.text: Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation: 在滿月之前，我會回到莫斯科比亞見她。我會變得足夠強大和快樂，這樣當我去見她時，她就不會再受苦了。

scripts.text: Could you please go to her and tell her my message?

scripts.text: I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.

scripts.text: Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation: 在滿月之前，我會回到莫斯科比亞見她。我會變得足夠強大和快樂，這樣當我去見她時，她就不會再受苦了。

scripts.text: ... I feel like I lost something precious.
scripts.translation: ...我感覺自己失去了什麼珍貴的東西。

scripts.text: - He looks down at the golden earrings and rubs it carefully -
scripts.translation: - 他低頭看著那對金耳環，小心翼翼地擦拭著 -

scripts.text: Who dares to come into my cave!
Are you Marozka? Maria sent me! I need your 'Golden Thread' to make a 'Golden Key' to release her from the wall!
scripts.translation: 你是馬羅茲卡嗎？瑪麗亞派我來的！我需要你的“金線”來做一把“黃金鑰匙”，把她從牆裡救出來！

scripts.text: Do you think that you are right for this job?
scripts.translation: 你以為自己適合做這件事嗎？

scripts.text: You must be fighting against 'Koshei' if you are asking about the 'Golden Key' and Maria! Do you think that you are strong enough to fight against him?
scripts.translation: 既然你在打聽“黃金鑰匙”和瑪麗亞，那你一定是在對抗“科舍伊”！你以為自己有足夠的實力與他戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: But, I need to test you to see if you truly are capable.
scripts.translation: 但我需要測試你，看看你是否真的有能力。

scripts.text: In this cave, there is a 'Stone Furnace' and an 'Apple Tree'.
scripts.translation: 在這個洞穴裡，有一個“石爐”和一棵“蘋果樹”。

scripts.text: You can escape from the cave with ^0000ff100 Well Baked Cookies^000000 from the Stone Furnace and ^0000ff100 Apples^000000 from the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation: 你可以用石爐裡的^0000ff100烤好的^000000餅乾和蘋果樹上的^0000ff100蘋^000000果離開洞穴。

scripts.text: It won't be easy. Monsters are wandering around the Stone Furnace and the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation: 這不會容易。魔物在石爐和蘋果樹周圍遊蕩。

scripts.text: Show me what you can do.
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
How did this rat get inside the cave?!
scripts.translation: 這隻老鼠是怎麼鑽進洞穴裡的？！

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
Are you Marozka? Here, I've proven to you my strength now can you make me the 'Golden Thread'?
scripts.translation: 你是馬羅茲卡嗎？我已經向你證明了我的實力，現在你能給我製作“金線”嗎？

scripts.text: I need it to get Maria out of that wall.
scripts.translation: 我需要它來把瑪麗亞從牆裡救出來。

scripts.text: As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation: 正如你所知，製作“金線”非常困難，而且需要很長的時間。

scripts.text: I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation: 我現在就開始製作...讓我看看...你能在一小時後回來找我嗎？

scripts.text: I have finally finished making the 'Golden Thread'. Just wait one more second and it'll be ready.
scripts.translation: 我終於完成了“金線”的製作。再等一秒，它就準備好了。

scripts.text: As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation: 正如你所知，製作“金線”非常困難，而且需要很長的時間。

scripts.text: I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation: 我現在就開始製作...讓我看看...你能在一小時後回來找我嗎？

scripts.text: So, you are really going to fight Koshei the Immportal, eh?
scripts.translation: 所以，你真的要去挑戰不死者科舍伊嗎？

scripts.text: I don't know but I promised to get Maria out of there.
scripts.translation: 我不知道，但我答應過要把瑪麗亞從那裡救出來。

scripts.text: Huh, Koshei is not your average adversary. Strength alone cannot beat him. You will need wisdom and an unfaltering spirit in order to win.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊可不是普通的對手。僅憑力量是無法戰勝他的。你需要智慧和堅定的意志才能獲勝。

scripts.text: Koshei will be extremely hostile to you because you are helping Maria.
scripts.translation: 因為你幫助了瑪麗亞，科舍伊會對你極度敵視。

scripts.text: Do you still want the Golden Thread? Ok, I will give it to you! But, there is one more test.
scripts.translation: 你還要金線嗎？好吧，我會給你的！但是，還有一個考驗。

scripts.text: Didn't I already prove my worth?
scripts.translation: 我不是已經證明了自己的價值嗎？

scripts.text: That was a test of your strength. Now you must pass the test of mind and wisdom.
scripts.translation: 那是對你力量的考驗。現在，你必須通過智慧和心智的考驗。

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
Ok then. Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation: 好吧。等你準備好了再回來。

scripts.text: You will... Ok, let's get to it. You must answer all of these questions correctly in order to pass the test.
scripts.translation: 你會...好吧，讓我們開始吧。你必須正確回答所有這些問題才能通過考驗。

scripts.text: What is deaf, dumb, and blind and always tells the truth?
scripts.translation: 什麼東西是聾的、啞的、瞎的，卻總是說真話？

scripts.text: If 4 cats can catch 4 mice every 4 minutes, what is the minimum number of cats needed to get 10 mice in 10 minutes?
scripts.translation: 如果4只貓每4分鐘能抓4只老鼠，那麼要在10分鐘內抓10只老鼠，最少需要幾隻貓？

scripts.text: Which of these gets shorter during winter and longer during summer?
scripts.translation: 下列哪樣東西在冬天會變短，在夏天會變長？

scripts.text: Doris Etticoat, wears a petticoat and has a red nose; the longer she stands, the shorter she grows. What is she?
scripts.translation: 多麗絲·艾提科特，穿著襯裙，有著紅色的鼻子；她站得越久，身體就越短。她是什麼？

scripts.text: My top and bottom are twins of a kind. The middle of me makes one body combined. If I stand tall and still, run faster I will. What am I?
scripts.translation: 我上下兩端是一對雙胞胎，中間把它們連成一個整體。我站直不動時，便能跑得更快。我是什麼？

scripts.text: Now let's see how you did.
scripts.translation: 現在來看看你的表現吧。

scripts.text: You got all of them correct.
I told you before that I wouldn't give you the Golden Thread until you got all questions correct.
scripts.translation: 我之前說過，除非你答對所有問題，否則我不會把金線給你。

scripts.text: It is not too late to try again. With wisdom comes patience.
scripts.translation: 現在再試一次也不晚。智慧伴隨著耐心。

scripts.text: I know that a quiz is a strange way of evaluating a person's wisdom. But, it is my way of knowing if you are truly committed to fighting Koshei.
scripts.translation: 我知道用問答來評判一個人的智慧有些奇怪。但這是我確認你是否真的下定決心要對抗科舍伊的方式。

scripts.text: I hope you help Maria with your strength and kindness.
scripts.translation: 希望你能用你的力量和善良去幫助瑪麗亞。

scripts.text: If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe.
scripts.translation: 你要是再在這裡閒逛，我就給自己煮一鍋美味的人肉湯！嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text: Why are you here, you yummy looking human? If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe
scripts.translation: 你這個看起來很美味的人類，為什麼在這裡？要是再在這裡閒逛，我就給自己煮一鍋美味的人肉湯！嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text: Do you want me to transform you into a savage beast?!
scripts.translation: 要不要我把你變成一隻野獸？！

scripts.text: Hmm? You are protected by a Protection Spell?
But, it was weake. My spell destroyed it.
scripts.translation: 不過這咒語太弱了，已經被我破除了。

scripts.text: Leave now, or I will curse you again! 'Presto...'
scripts.translation: 現在離開，否則我會再次詛咒你！“變變變...”

scripts.text: Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
What are you planning to do with that weak spell!?
scripts.translation: 你打算用那個弱小的咒語做什麼？！

scripts.text: Ho, you are protected by a Protection Spell. You are no ordinary kid.
scripts.translation: 哦，你被保護咒語保護著。你不是普通的小孩。

scripts.text: I heard that you are able to make the 'Golden Key' and that's why I am here!

scripts.text: So, that is why I helped you out by making the 'Golden Key'.
